subtype: Approach: giving in to avoid losing the relationship [Pitfall]
passage:
“Didi, can I ask you something? Don't laugh.” Lokesh sat on the edge of her bed, twisting his phone in his hands.
“Okay. What's wrong?”
“I sent Reet some private pictures. Last month. She said everyone does, and that she'd leave if I didn't.”
“And now?”
“Now I can't sleep. What if she shows them to someone? What if they go around school?” His voice broke.
Gurpreet put her laptop aside. “Look at me. This isn't your fault. She pushed, and you were scared of losing her. That's a lot of pressure.”
“Are you angry?”
“No. I'm worried, and I'm glad you told me. Tonight we tell Mummy and Papa together, and tomorrow we talk to your school counsellor. Adults can help you decide what to do next.”
Lokesh nodded, tears on his cheeks. “Okay.”

qa.q: What did Reet say to make Lokesh send the pictures?
qa.a: Reet said everyone does, and that she'd leave if Lokesh didn't.
Lokesh is scared and sleepless, since he worries the pictures might go around school.
Lokesh could tell his parents and the school counsellor, as Gurpreet says, since adults can help him decide what to do.

qa.q: How might Gurpreet feel hearing this?
qa.a: Gurpreet is worried but glad, and stays calm and kind so that Lokesh knows it is not his fault.

grounding: A teen shares private photos because everyone does and he will otherwise be left, valuing the relationship over comfort, and later fears where they might travel.

subtype: Approach: giving in to avoid losing the relationship [Pitfall]
passage: I'm Lakshmi, and I'm writing this a year later because I promised the counsellor I would. In Class 11, Deepak and I had been together four months when he started asking for "private photos". Everybody does it, he said. If I really loved him, I wouldn't make him beg. And once, quietly: "Maybe I should find someone who trusts me." I didn't want to send them. My hands were cold when I did. I told myself it was the price of keeping him. He ended things anyway, six weeks later. After that I couldn't sleep. Who had seen them? Were they on someone's phone right now? One afternoon I finally told Ms. Pinto, the counsellor. She said, "This is not your fault," called my mother in that same afternoon, and helped us report the photos and ask for them to be taken down.

qa.q: How long had Deepak and Lakshmi been together when the asking began?
qa.a: They had been together four months.

qa.q: What was Lakshmi feeling while sending the photos?
qa.a: Lakshmi felt uneasy and pressured, hands cold, sending them only out of fear of losing Deepak.

qa.q: Which choice could have protected Lakshmi earlier?
qa.a: Refusing and telling a trusted adult when Deepak first pushed, since pressure and threats to leave are warning signs, not proof of love.

qa.q: How does Ms. Pinto see what happened to Lakshmi?
qa.a: Ms. Pinto sees Lakshmi as someone who was pressured, not someone to blame, and acts that same afternoon by calling the mother and helping report the photos.

grounding: Shows a teen sending private photos under a partner's pressure to keep the relationship, then fearing where they might travel before getting adult help.

subtype: Approach: giving in to avoid losing the relationship [Pitfall]
passage:
Counsellor's note, Wednesday, 3:40 pm.
Karthik (Class 12) came in after the last period and sat with his bag on his lap, speaking to the floor. Two months ago, his boyfriend Deepak pushed him to send private photos, saying everyone did it and that he would end things otherwise. Karthik sent them to keep the relationship. They split up last week. Since then, Karthik said, he checks his phone every few minutes, afraid the photos are being passed around.
I told him plainly that this is not his fault and that telling me was the right step. With his agreement I called his father, who came to school within the hour. We noted the dates and messages, and I explained how the school will help report the images and ask for them to be removed.
I will check in with Karthik tomorrow morning before assembly.

qa.q: When did Karthik and Deepak split up?
What is Karthik worried about now?
qa.a: Karthik is afraid the photos are being passed around, and anxiously checks the phone every few minutes.

qa.q: What choice might have protected Karthik two months ago?
qa.a: Saying no and telling a trusted adult when Deepak threatened to end things, since pressure like that is a warning, not a test of love.

qa.q: How does the counsellor see Karthik's situation?
qa.a: The counsellor sees Karthik as someone harmed by pressure, not someone to blame, and moves quickly by calling the father and planning a check-in.

grounding: Illustrates a teen who shared private photos because a partner said everyone does and threatened to leave, and who now fears where they might travel.
